subject.title: fix: keep inbound metadata in runtime context

question: Should maintainers refresh and land this focused runtime-context handoff, or make the newer tail-carrier/cache-stability branch the canonical implementation?
rationale: Both branches touch the same current-turn metadata boundary, and automation cannot safely choose the permanent prompt-cache placement and landing order while the newer branch is still open and under review.

options.title: Make Tail Carrier Canonical
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 passes review, use it as the canonical landing path because it preserves the context handoff while addressing the prompt-cache placement concern.

options.title: Refresh This Focused Branch
options.body: Resolve the conflicts here and land the smaller clean-prompt fix first, leaving tail placement and provider cache anchors as follow-up work.

options.title: Fold Into Reply Metadata Work
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 is the chosen contract, port this PR's clean-prompt coverage there and close this branch only after that path is safe.

recommendation.title: Make Tail Carrier Canonical
